annotation.title_clean: 关于做好专业学位研究生以实践成果申请学位工作的意见
annotation.title_en: Opinions on Doing Well the Work of Professional Degree Graduate Students Applying for Degrees Based on Practical Achievements
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院学位委员会办公室 (Office of the Academic Degrees Committee of the State Council)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Academic Degrees Committee Office opinion on allowing professional-degree graduate students to obtain degrees based on practical achievements instead of only theses. It assigns roles to guidance committees, degree-granting institutions and provincial authorities, covering quality assurance, industry participation and supervisor training. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Professional degree committees issue basic requirements for theses and practical achievements for degree applications
Degree-granting institutions must set detailed rules and full-process guidelines for practical-achievement applications
Industry mentors and experts get larger roles in evaluation and defense
Sampling inspection of achievements, linked to degree-point evaluation, enforces quality
Provincial education authorities coordinate sampling and monitoring
